D01.label: accurate
D01.note_text: Lisa reports that Ronald drinks eight large cans of strong lager per day and has a bottle of vodka that is consumed in two days. Lisa sees the empties of the cans and vodka in the bin every Sunday and counts them.
D01.why: amounts, vodka, two days and source (bin) all kept, attributed to Lisa

D02.label: accurate
D02.note_text: Ronald has a history of drinking, consuming a couple of cans of lager with tea in the evening.
D02.why: 'couple of cans with tea' kept; though stated as fact rather than as his account, Lisa's higher figure follows directly and his denial is in s14

D03.label: softened
D03.note_text: Ronald fell in the kitchen after tripping on a mat. ... Ronald fell in the hall in the summer after drinking.
D03.why: kitchen fall recorded only as Ron's 'tripped on a mat'; Lisa's account that he had been drinking since dinner time and lay on the floor all night unable to get up is lost

notes: Drink-driving recorded as Mrs Okafor's report to Lisa, with Ron's denial. The kitchen fall merges Ron's and Lisa's versions and keeps only Ron's cause.
